note: Global top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New project', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'To do list', 'Help', user avatar

Project sidebar navigation -- renders: 'Project information', 'Repository', 'Commits', 'Branches', 'Tags', 'Contributors', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'Pipelines', 'Deployments', 'Packages', 'Infrastructure', 'Monitor', 'Analytics', 'Wiki', 'Snippets', 'Settings'; excludes the project name header which is user-defined
Breadcrumbs -- renders: 'byteblaze', 'dotfiles', 'Commits' (namespace and project name are fixed for this specific repository context)
Commit list controls -- renders: branch selector, 'Commits' breadcrumb, search input, and view toggle buttons
Commit date group headers -- renders: fixed date strings (e.g., 'Today', 'Yesterday', '12 Mar 2024') determined by the commit timestamps
Commit SHA controls -- renders: truncated commit hash and copy/view buttons
GPG signature status indicator -- renders: fixed status labels like 'Invalid' or 'Verified'
